name: Medieval Town of Toruń
description: Toruń, a city on Poland's Vistula River, began as a Teutonic Order castle in the mid-13th century and grew rich as a Hanseatic trading port. Its compact Old and New Towns still follow their original street layout, lined with grand 14th- and 15th-century buildings. Among them is the house where astronomer Nicolaus Copernicus was born, a draw for visitors.
